tools.detail: Uptime Robot is a reliable tool designed for website and API monitoring. It ensures that your online services are always up and running by sending regular checks to your website or API. Key features include customizable monitoring intervals, alert notifications via email, SMS, or webhooks, and a user-friendly dashboard that provides real-time insights. Uptime Robot is ideal for developers, IT professionals, and small to medium-sized businesses looking for a straightforward and effective monitoring solution. Pros: It's easy to set up and use, offers multiple monitoring options, and provides comprehensive alerts. Limitations: The free plan has limitations on the number of monitors and alert methods.
